description:
AI Engineer 


 Required Qualifications

 
 8+ years of software engineering experience, including strong hands-on development in JavaScript/TypeScript, with recent experience building, enhancing, and supporting Generative AI/LLM-based applications in production environments.

 Experience developing, enhancing, and supporting production-grade enterprise applications or platforms.

 Hands-on experience building Generative AI / LLM-based applications and capabilities .

 Experience integrating applications with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI services, and enterprise APIs.

 Understanding of key GenAI concepts including:
 
 Prompt engineering

 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

 AI agents and agentic workflows

 Tool/function calling

 Context and conversation management

 Model evaluation and monitoring

 

 Experience building and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems and data sources.

 Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues across application, integration, AI/model, and platform layers.

 Experience with modern software engineering practices including source control, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and production deployments.

 Understanding of security, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and responsible AI considerations for enterprise AI applications.

 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 Experience working on an enterprise AI platform  or shared GenAI platform.

 Experience developing AI applications using JavaScript/TypeScript-based frameworks and SDKs .

 Experience building or supporting AI agents and multi-step AI workflows.

 Experience with RAG, embeddings, semantic search, or enterprise knowledge retrieval.

 Familiarity with AI observability, model evaluation, prompt/version management, usage monitoring, and cost optimization.

 Experience integrating AI capabilities with multiple enterprise applications and APIs.

 Familiarity with cloud-based AI services and foundation models.

 Experience supporting business-critical applications in a production environment.

 
 Core Skills

 JavaScript / TypeScript | Generative AI | LLM Integration | AI Agents | RAG | API Development & Integration | Prompt Engineering | Production Support | AI Observability | Enterprise Application Development 

  

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 50,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 175,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post.
